column5: Here's how YardSwaps works, start to finish, with one pressure washer that's been sitting in the garage.
Tap Sell. Before you take photos, open Photo tips. Get the whole item in the frame, and add a close-up of any label or nameplate. The AI reads the brand and model.
Choose your photos. Here, one of the whole washer and one of the label. The AI reads both and fills in the title and the category.
It read the brand, Hotsy, right off the label. Check what it filled in before you post.
It also suggests a price range from the photos. Tap Use price, or type your own. The condition and the description are already written.
Tap Publish. Listing is free, and your listing is live in the feed and in search.
Now the buyer's side. Someone nearby searches pressure washer, finds it two miles away, and opens it to check the photos, the details, and what to look at before buying.
They can make an offer. Tap an amount or type your own, and send it. The seller can accept it or counter.
Or message the seller to set a time. Every deal is a local pickup. Meet somewhere safe, run the equipment, and pay only when you're satisfied.
Selling as a business? A storefront puts every unit you list under your company name, with your hours, your service area, a search box, and one link to share.
Start a storefront free for thirty days. After that, the first hundred storefronts pay our founding price of twenty-nine dollars a month for three months, then forty-nine dollars a month.
Get YardSwaps free on the App Store or Google Play, or go to yardswaps dot com.
